Photo album

Trance

Concept

Introduction

This is a photo album compiled from the works I shot during my photography course at the end of 2023. When choosing the shooting locations, I traveled back and forth between Shenzhen and Hong Kong, so most of the photos in this collection record the landscapes of these two places.
The photography process lasted about two months. During this period, I went from having no interest in photography at all to discovering my own preferences through random captures. This set of photos documents my journey from unconsciousness to consciousness.
The album is titled "Trance" precisely because of this.
